status: refused; mechanical deliverables complete; visual self-check fails hard terrain constraints

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; delivered water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No coherent cast-shadow field is visible, but basalt top planes remain lighter than adjacent cliff faces and conifer branch tiers contain internal light-dark modelling. The aggregate orientation statistic does not override the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad west and east transition ground and the two exposed crossing shoulders count as buildable; exposed coastal and inlet cliff faces count as steep; dense forest, talus, shingle and broken rim rock make up the remainder. Approximate uncertainty is plus or minus 0.08 per land-relative fraction.

crown.method: Manual full-frame census at native resolution and in all four 2x quadrant crops; every visually distinguishable conifer crown, including saplings, overlaps and edge-clipped crowns, was included, with a 29 source-pixel median scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution colour-constrained trace inside inspected water envelopes, explicit seeds for disconnected visible reaches, short edge and foam growth, and enclosed-hole fill; inspected against a full-resolution magenta overlay.
waterMask.limitation: The narrow east-side channels are broken into many exposed painted reaches by stones and ground occlusion, so the binary mask has multiple connected components. Exact wet-edge placement remains a human visual gate.

refusalReasons: The literal neutral-lighting rule fails by eye: basalt upper planes and many crown branch tiers are visibly lighter than adjacent vertical or lower faces.
Conifer crowns contain internal light-dark branch modelling rather than one flat value from tip to skirt.
Grey-blue haze is too weak to visibly soften every crown edge across the dense stands.
openRisks: The two bare crossing shoulders are present, but their requested world-space separation and usable level area are not mechanically established from the raster and appear narrower than the brief's target.
The water mask is mechanically same-size and binary, but exact inclusion of every shallow east-channel wash pixel remains a human visual judgment.
verified: Exactly one built-in whole-canvas edit call used both required images.
The 1254 x 1254 source copy is hash-identical to the raw generated PNG.
No buildings, walls, roads, bridges, docks, boats, fences, figures, track, sleepers or tunnel mouths were observed.
The water mask dimensions match the source and its opaque pixels are white.
The crown object is complete, includes saplings, and reports no exclusions.
unverified: Pipeline stitch, shipped-canvas upscale and runtime appearance.
World-space cliff height, inlet width and crossing-shoulder separation.
outputScope: .codex-tmp/authoring/cells/tanium/c1-2/ only; public/ and art-source/ were not modified.
